## Purpose and Entry Points
Openship is a self-hostable deployment control plane: it detects source projects, builds/releases them, runs workloads, and manages routing, TLS, backups, monitoring, mail, and automation. The primary API process starts in `apps/api/src/index.ts` and composes the application in `apps/api/src/app.ts`. Users drive it through:
- CLI: `apps/cli/src/index.ts`
- Browser dashboard: `apps/dashboard/src/app/layout.tsx`
- Electron desktop shell: `apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts`
- MCP/agent endpoint: `apps/api/src/modules/mcp/mcp-server.ts`

## Control Plane and Persistence
The TypeScript/Bun control plane is organized as API modules, with route/controller/service boundaries under `apps/api/src/modules`. Shared domain contracts and parsing live in `packages/core/src/index.ts`; persistence is a Drizzle-backed database package with migrations and repository abstractions in `packages/db/src/schema/index.ts` and `packages/db/src/repos/index.ts`. The data model covers organizations/auth, projects/services, deployments, domains, servers, credentials, jobs, backup state, and audit records. Runtime state and concurrency are guarded through deployment/provision locks and execution leases.

## Project-to-Deployment Pipeline
Deployment orchestration centers on `apps/api/src/modules/deployments/deployment.service.ts`, `apps/api/src/modules/deployments/build-pipeline.ts`, and `apps/api/src/modules/deployments/prepare.service.ts`. A source (GitHub, local folder, artifact, or Compose config) is resolved into a frozen deployment configuration, preflighted for target capacity/ports/routing, then built and deployed. Compose has a dedicated sub-pipeline at `apps/api/src/modules/deployments/compose/pipeline.ts`. Runtime adapters abstract target-specific execution—Docker, bare supervised processes, cloud workloads, builds, source transfer, and Git cloning—under `packages/adapters/src/runtime/index.ts`, `packages/adapters/src/runtime/docker.ts`, and `packages/adapters/src/runtime/bare.ts`.

## Execution Boundaries: Local, Remote, and Cloud
Projects target local Docker/host execution, SSH-connected servers, or Openship Cloud. System adapters isolate privileged machine operations such as SSH command execution, Docker installation/control, and proxy provisioning: `packages/adapters/src/system/ssh-executor.ts`, `packages/adapters/src/system/docker-edge-executor.ts`, and `packages/adapters/src/system/setup.ts`. The API holds server sessions and SSH tunnel management in `apps/api/src/lib/ssh-manager.ts` and `apps/api/src/lib/ssh-tunnel-manager.ts`. Cloud access is explicitly separated through `apps/api/src/lib/cloud/transport.ts` and cloud module services under `apps/api/src/modules/cloud`.

## Edge Routing, Domains, and TLS
The edge is OpenResty/Nginx-based (`apps/edge/nginx.conf`) and owns public HTTP(S) routing rather than application containers. Deployment routes are registered after workloads become reachable; domain/routing application is handled by `apps/api/src/modules/domains/routing-apply.service.ts` and `apps/api/src/lib/route-apply.service.ts`. Certificate/domain lifecycle, DNS challenges, and renewal scheduling are concentrated in `apps/api/src/lib/domain-ssl.ts`, `apps/api/src/lib/edge-challenge.ts`, and `apps/api/src/lib/ssl-scheduler.ts`. Embedded Lua supports request logging, routing rules, and edge management in `packages/adapters/src/infra/lua`.

## User Interfaces and Streaming Control
The Next.js dashboard is a client for API modules, with a same-origin proxy at `apps/dashboard/src/app/api/proxy/[...path]/route.ts`; deployment interaction state is coordinated in `apps/dashboard/src/context/deployment`. CLI commands call the same backend using `apps/cli/src/lib/api-client.ts`, while the desktop app packages/runs local control-plane services through `apps/desktop/src/main/services.ts`. SSE and WebSocket-style terminal/log streams are first-class interfaces, including `apps/api/src/lib/sse.ts`, `apps/api/src/lib/run-sse.ts`, and the dashboard’s `apps/dashboard/src/hooks/useSSEStream.ts`.

## Operations and Integrated Services
Self-hosted Compose mode deploys Postgres, Redis, API, dashboard, and host-networked edge via `docker/docker-compose.yml`; the API can control host Docker through its mounted socket, a privileged trust boundary. Redis supports caching/rate limits and BullMQ jobs through `apps/api/src/lib/cache-store/redis.ts` and `apps/api/src/lib/job-runner/bullmq.ts`. GitHub integration supports repository access and push webhooks (`apps/api/src/modules/github/github.webhook.ts`). Backups use pluggable local/S3/SFTP destinations in `packages/adapters/src/backup`, while the mail subsystem provisions and manages a bundled mail engine through `apps/api/src/modules/mail/mail-engine.ts` and `apps/email/Dockerfile`.
